Section: Next steps
Part 2 of 2
==================================================
## Next steps

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Next steps] [admitted cases]

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Next steps] Please advise us which medical expert(s) you are proposing to instruct.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Next steps] Please also supply us with your client’s schedule of past and future expenses [if any] which are claimed, even if this can only be supplied on a provisional basis at present to assist us with making an appropriate reserve. [non-admitted cases]

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Next steps] Please confirm we may now close our file. Alternatively, if you intend to proceed please advise which experts you are proposing to instruct.

## Alternative dispute resolution

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Alternative dispute resolution] Include details of any options that may be considered whether on a without prejudice basis or otherwise. Yours faithfully,

## Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (Where the original document is not in English and the party has obtained an English translation both documents should be disclosed.)

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] Disclosure by the Defendant to be provided with the letter of response where requested in the letter of claim.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (1) A copy of all contractual documents relating to the package holiday purchased by the claimant, including but not limited to:

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (a)any relevant brochure or other marketing materials;

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (b)the booking form and any written confirmation of booking;

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (c)the invoice;

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (d)the terms and conditions relating to the booking.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (2) Any accident\illness report relating to the claimant, including details of any investigations carried out.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (3) Any report by the claimant relating to the hotel/resort and/or tour operator.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (4) Any records/illness logs and other records detailing the number of complaints of gastric illness made by other guests suitably redacted to omit any personal data staying at the hotel/resort for the period beginning three months prior to the commencement of the stay and ending at the last day of the claimant’s stay at the said hotel/resort.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (5) Health and safety reports in respect of the hotel/resort, including records of inspections or hygiene safety checks (whether internal or independent) for the period beginning three months prior to the commencement of the stay and ending at the last day of the claimant’s stay at the said hotel/resort.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (6) Documents providing information, guidance and training to employees or agents of the hotel/resort in relation to food or general hygiene standards.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (7) Food temperature checks covering the duration of the claimant’s stay at the hotel/resort in respect of all areas in which food is served and for all meals served.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (8) Freezer and refrigerator temperature checks covering the duration of the claimant’s stay at the hotel/resort in respect of all areas in which food is stored and/or served.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (9) Documents relating to any maintenance and/or testing of swimming pools at the hotel/resort and the results of any such tests during the period beginning three months prior to the commencement of the stay and ending at the last day of the claimant’s stay at the said hotel/resort.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] Disclosure to be provided by the claimant on receipt of a denial of liability (including a denial of causation only).

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (1) Receipts/proof of purchase for any medication purchased by the claimant to alleviate the alleged symptoms.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (2 )Details of any excursions/trips/days out and/or consumption of food and drink by the claimant outside the hotel/resort.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (3) Any relevant entries within bank and credit card statements of the claimant relating to the period of the stay.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (4) Relevant claimant medical records, including all records referring to the specific symptoms, all attendances with regard to similar illness symptoms, all records during the entire prognosis period and all records in relation to any other claim(s) made in relation to holiday illness.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (5) Relevant photographs/images taken during the period of stay together with, where available, the associated metadata of any digital images.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] (6) Social media posts relating to the claimant in the period beginning one month prior to the onset of the alleged symptoms and ending one month after the claimant’s recovery.

[Pre-action protocol for resolution of package travel claims > Annex B: Specimen standard disclosure list] Updated: Sunday, 1 October 2023
